proposal.reason: Main change is CI execution logic: .github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml, source-sanity.yml, and pccl-daily-full.yml now resolve pccl-tests by matching branch with fallback, add authenticated registry pull, and pin workflow_dispatch builds to label-instants, changing test/build orchestration and artifact reproducibility owned by ci. Secondary build scope is independently substantive in .github/workflows/scripts/pccl_for_test_hggcrt13_ubuntu24_build.sh, which reorders two build passes and unsets LDFLAGS for --enable_tests to alter linker-flag application and fix unit-test link behavior, a compiler/link invocation concern owned by build.
